purpose: Pre-registered acceptance criteria of S6 (feasibility gate + benchmark infrastructure, the two outstanding items of the Phase 4C plan: original S3 and S4). Committed BEFORE any S6 implementation. Thresholds are engineering/protocol thresholds fixed here and never tuned to results; the implementation reads them from this file.
scope: synthetic fixtures only; no market backtest, no strategy implementation, no Family B, no holdout access (not even metadata), no paid service, no change to T1-T10 or risk thresholds; a passed feasibility gate NEVER authorises a market evaluation

feasibility_gate.rule: schema completeness: every required field present with the right type; unknown fields, NaN/inf, malformed input and any internal exception make the gate FAIL (fail closed)
economic rationale: hypothesis, rationale, counterparty/source of the edge, >= 2 expected failure modes, a falsifiable prediction

causality: every indicator declares completed-candle inputs and a window; warm-up >= max window + 1; evaluation window inside the research bounds and >= 3 years; dataset hash equals the frozen S4 hash; universe settings within thresholds
execution/costs: engine quantlab.execution, fill at the next candle open, costs not below BASE, a stress scenario, participation cap <= 0.10, min notional >= 5
risk compatibility: S2 risk layer with the frozen config hash, universe guard on, spot only, no leverage/shorting/averaging/position adjustment
complexity: <= 3 free parameters per configuration, <= 3 configurations, scalar fixed values only (no ranges, grids or search spaces), convention parameters need a stated source

power: Monte Carlo over the declared ranges (seeded): 5th percentile of raw episodes >= 200 AND of effective episodes (cluster/correlation adjusted) >= 80 AND 95th percentile of the minimum detectable annualised Sharpe <= 1.5
budget/ledger: budget caps, N cap 52, stop rule and the registered-family count respected after adding the family; the budget baseline matches the frozen S5 record
duplicates: spec hash, family id, title and configuration hashes not already registered; family key not in the rejected set
retrospective-change protection: results_seen must be false, prior_looks 0, gate thresholds in the document absent or equal to the frozen ones; a frozen spec hash must match
holdout declaration: holdout_access false and the known metadata exposures (S1 listing, S3 survivorship reporting, S4 symbol names, request-log gap) acknowledged
determinism: identical result for identical input, for permuted key order, and across two processes
a gate pass never authorises a market run: the result carries authorizes_market_evaluation false, and may_start_market_run requires the budget and a separate owner approval record
calibration: the gate FAILS Family A as specified (about 14 expected episodes) and PASSES a synthetic example; each individual check can be made to fail by one targeted mutation

benchmarks.rule: registry: legacy B1-B5 keep their definitions (text hash equals protocol v3), new benchmarks have new ids; frozen in benchmark_registry.json
every benchmark runs through the Stage 0 engine with the same ExecConfig (costs, slippage, liquidity cap, min notional, valuation) as a strategy would

closed-form checks on synthetic fixtures: cash constant; buy-and-hold net return equals the hand calculation with costs; equal-weight weights; volatility-target exposure formula; exposure-/volatility-matched and cash-mix definitions
causality: >= 20 seeded perturbations of future candles leave every benchmark order before the perturbation unchanged

point-in-time behaviour: members that later end are held while members, non-members never bought, stale/missing/quarantined/identity-transition/insufficient-liquidity cases fail closed and are reported (stuck positions listed)

comparison metrics closed-form on synthetic series: net return, CAGR, max drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, turnover, costs, exposure, tail risk (CVaR, worst day), active return, tracking error, information ratio; paired block bootstrap deterministic; Holm over the comparison set
random-timing null: deterministic with a fixed seed; false-positive rate near alpha under a true null and detection under injected timing skill on synthetic data
determinism across two processes for every benchmark run

risk_review.rule: stale held position review: behaviour of RiskManagedStrategy + engine when a held asset stops printing candles is characterised by synthetic tests and documented, including valuation at the last close; no change to frozen S2 risk parameters or code

regression.rule: full local suite and check.sh pass; S2, S4 and S5 freeze tests, protocol verification and T1-T10 unchanged; budget state unchanged (N 43, 0 families); ledger amendment for the S6 audit entry
CI on the final code commit: Quant CI, zizmor, pre-commit and all upstream test jobs pass; any cancelled job is recorded as an infrastructure limitation, never as a pass

design_only.rule: a design-only proposal for the next strategy family exists (rationale, failure modes, parameter complexity, benchmark comparisons, budget allocation); nothing is implemented or evaluated; the budget state still shows 0 further families

decision.GO: all gates pass (GO for S6 infrastructure only; no market evaluation, no family implementation)
decision.NO_GO: any gate fails; documented, thresholds not changed after the fact
